freeze_authorization: Development-informed v4 conditional freeze before combined bridge and all prospective model outcomes. Execution requires2/2 clean bridge trials; no legacy fallback.

conditions.intended: Exact already-offset historical physical cell; apply no further placement shift.

early_termination: Actual safety termination only; no early success termination.

nominal_scene.units: meters, kilograms, seconds, radians; UR controller base frame; Z up

gripper.geometry_source: Rounded pad/backing contact hulls and70mm effective custom-pad aperture fitted against measured grasp; nominal bare Robotiqstroke remains85mm. Contact/material parameters are uncalibrated estimates.

camera.source: artifacts/isaac_waffles/evidence/camera_refinement_frozen_physics.json; balancedC, September4 fitting only, no hardware optical calibration.

uncertainty.geometry: Table, bin, mat, packet and custom pad sizes are visual estimates; no ruler or calibrated extrinsics recovered.
uncertainty.physics: Packet is a rigid collision body. Wrapper flex, wafer fracture, gel friction/compliance and motor response remain uncalibrated.
uncertainty.camera: Camera fit is episode-specific; do not pool sessions with changed camera mounting.

calibration.physical_fit: Two fixed fit episodes; table plane, rounded contact hulls, effective aperture and per-episode initial packet pose estimated from images/contact events. No object attachment or pose replay.
calibration.validation: Recorded-motion reproduction; does not establish calibrated force/tactile transfer or policy success.

execution_order: One paired sampling-seed block at a time, candidate order counterbalanced exactly as frozen; model reloads and native latency retained.

inference_settings.latency: Native measured model inference latency plus configured response delay; RPC serialization/postprocessing overhead recorded separately, not advanced on simulated clock. Same model for all trials; exploratory timing transfer.

observation_delay_semantics: Sensor-history transport delay for camera/state/tactile/wrist. snapshot.t and request/action grids remain current; locally known accepted-gripper-command history stays current, matching native SnapshotBuilder. Executor and safety feedback stay current. Causal sensor samples only.
comparability_requirements: All prospective teachers use the same bridge-validated corrected profile, fixed historical scene/start and September4 baseline.
Physical placement is primary; later stops and clean completion remain separate.
The source and numerical profile are fixed before bridge outcomes; bridge failure blocks model scoring with no fallback.

analysis.weighting: One fixed physical condition with six matched prospective sampling seeds per teacher.
analysis.paired_interval_method: Generic scenario comparison disabled: tools/sim/select_teacher_anchor.py resamples matched SEED pairs, not the single scene row.
analysis.interval_interpretation: Descriptive scenario-resampling intervals for this fixed sensitivity suite, not population-level hardware/generalization bounds. Two seeds provide limited sampling uncertainty. Degenerate bootstrap intervals do not establish equivalence.
analysis.missing_trials: Report scheduled-denominator success bounds and all missing/invalid cases. Paired inference requires complete condition×seed matches; incomplete contrasts are explicitly partial.
analysis.safety_stop: Preserve observed physical task outcome; report safety stops separately, including after achieved placement.
analysis.early_failure: Do not discard or replace an executed policy failure. Retry only demonstrable infrastructure failure before any policy command, with explicit linked attempt metadata.
analysis.freeze_policy: Do not tune thresholds, cases or comparisons after observing policy outcomes. Any amendment creates a new campaign id/hash.
analysis.reproduction_note: All historical controls, components and combined-profile bridge trials are excluded from prospective model ranking.

case_manifest.analysis_outputs: Written separately from raw trial directories.

runtime_hardware.recipe: Unchanged force/speed/workspace configuration from teacher pickup; optional lift-complete stop disabled. Placement release is a separate explicit adapter profile.

post_stop_observation_semantics: Only actual stops shorten the full60s physics horizon. FINISH prevents replans, returns stopped=False and remains under safety monitoring through the horizon.

terminal_veto.provenance: Episode teacher5016 direct p_close,p_none,retries,floor; remaining task defaults recovered from recorded git fd4a032. live selects newer native pad-based recovery logic.

development_split_note: V4 amendment used prior gel-only development outcomes. The two combined bridge seeds are reused development inputs and excluded from model ranking; all24 screen and24 confirmation outcomes are prospective.

reference_case.physical_outcome: Existing ordered full_task + bin_support, independent of later stop; clean finish separatelyreported.
